chapter: Reel 2: carnival, Prohibition, funerals and clubs
title: Carnival and Indians in the neighborhood
summary: Allen asks about Carnival uptown; they recall few masqueraders and Indians who made up back of town.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Parading for Mardi Gras and the clubs

blocks.x: He's a nephew. Yeah, that's his nephew, that drummer. Yeah. Interesting. What about Carnival up here?

What did y'all do at Carnival? Up here? In Carrollton now. Well, on this, at Carnival we have this Coralian class that come out, the Red Street. Mm-hm. What about Carnival up here? What did y'all do at Carnival?

Up here? In Carrollton now? The only thing that we have is for a day that comes out to Red Street. That's the only square we have. They have one that comes up around the building. That's why I see it's not here. But the parade is part of the parade. That was a town called. Not parade. Parade from Oak Street. Yeah, from Oak Street. From Oak Street.
Is that a late parade or is that an old parade? No, that's not an old parade. Yeah. Did y'all have any masters up here? When you got married?

Yeah, all the masters used to have around here. Very few. They were Indians. They'd pass up and down a little while. They'd go all and go and lift them. After they eat a cock, nine times, they'd see nothing around here. Everybody's going downtown.
The Indian tribes were from the neighborhood? They had some from up here?
Yeah, they were. Oh yeah, they used to make up back here. Yeah, they were gone.
All of these people were custom.
All from around the nigger towns. All of the nigger towns. They all land back here. Make up. Where was this?
What streets? What was the place where they came from? About nigger towns.
Nigger towns. Where is that? On the other side of the George. It's all the comic making all around 5th Street on the other side of the road.

Oh yeah, above Audubon Park. Yeah. Between Audubon Park and Broadway Run. Yeah, all around that new man. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. I know that neighborhood, but I... That's where all the Indians used to come from all of them. I never did see any Indians there. Yeah. Sometimes I see the Jefferson City buzzards, but that's on the other side of the road. Yeah. That's an old club, the buzzards. They used to be called the Muddy Grubs. They used to be called the Muddy Grubs. Muddy Grubs? I think they got muddy so they called them the muddy girls.
